2026.name: Bahrain Grand Prix
2026.speedTrapInsight: The long start-finish straight rewards top-speed efficiency. Low-drag setups tend to gain here.

2026.name: Saudi Arabian Grand Prix
2026.speedTrapInsight: Jeddah's high-speed flowing layout means sustained top speed through long corners rewards active aero efficiency.

2026.name: Australian Grand Prix
2026.speedTrapInsight: Albert Park's mix of fast and slow corners creates a balance challenge; straight-line speed is less decisive here.
